address: Duc Carles de Borja 28, Gandia, 46701, Spain
bio: The couple at the helm, with Paco Castelló at the wheel in the kitchen and Gabri Tarín in charge of the dining room, declare themselves to be 100% Mediterranean, so that gastronomic culture is evident in every dish. In this small restaurant, located in a pedestrianised street in the old town (the area known as La Ciudad Ducal), you will find a proposal that revolves exclusively around surprise menus (Ona and Ona Cuina Oberta) that change daily, depending on the market and always giving a great deal of prominence to fish and vegetables. We have loved their tiger nut ajoblanco with cherry granita, and the vegetable carbonara!...
